```python
# app/views/orchestrator_panel.py

from typing import Dict, List, Optional

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QPointF
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QPainterPath, QPen
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QGraphicsItem,
    QGraphicsPathItem,
    QGraphicsRectItem,
    QGraphicsScene,
    QGraphicsSimpleTextItem,
    QGraphicsView,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from app.db.orchestrator_repo import OrchestratorRepository
from app.db.pipeline_repo import PipelineRepository
from app.domain.pipeline_models import RetryPolicy
from app.services.audit_service import AuditService
from app.services.dead_letter_service import DeadLetterService
from app.services.dependency_service import DependencyService
from app.services.orchestrator_service import OrchestratorService
from app.services.pipeline_service import PipelineService
from app.services.pipeline_version_service import PipelineVersionService
from app.workers.orchestrator_worker import OrchestratorWorker


class PipelineNode(QGraphicsRectItem):
    NODE_TYPE = 65536

    def __init__(self, pipeline_id: int, title: str):
        super().__init__(0, 0, 180, 70)

        self.pipeline_id_value = pipeline_id

        self.setFlag(QGraphicsItem.GraphicsItemFlag.ItemIsMovable, True)
        self.setFlag(QGraphicsItem.GraphicsItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable, True)

        self.setBrush(QColor("#1F2937"))
        self.setPen(QPen(QColor("#2563EB"), 2))

        self.text_item = QGraphicsSimpleTextItem(self)
        self.text_item.setText(title)
        self.text_item.setPos(12, 24)
        self.text_item.setColor(QColor("#E5E7EB"))

        self.id_item = QGraphicsSimpleTextItem(self)
        self.id_item.setText(f"ID {pipeline_id}")
        self.id_item.setPos(12, 8)
        self.id_item.setColor(QColor("#9CA3AF"))

    def pipeline_id(self) -> int:
        return self.pipeline_id_value

    def itemChange(self, change, value):
        if change == QGraphicsItem.GraphicsItemChange.ItemPositionHasChanged:
            scene = self.scene()

            if isinstance(scene, PipelineScene):
                scene.update_edges_for_node(self)

        return super().itemChange(change, value)


class EdgeItem(QGraphicsPathItem):
    def __init__(self, source: PipelineNode, target: PipelineNode):
        super().__init__()

        self.source = source
        self.target = target

        self.setPen(QPen(QColor("#22D3EE"), 2))
        self.setZValue(-1)

        self.update_path()

    def update_path(self):
        p1 = self.source.mapToScene(self.source.boundingRect().center())
        p2 = self.target.mapToScene(self.target.boundingRect().center())

        path = QPainterPath()
        path.moveTo(p1)
        path.lineTo(p2)

        self.setPath(path)


class PipelineScene(QGraphicsScene):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)

        self.nodes: Dict[int, PipelineNode] = {}
        self.edges: List[EdgeItem] = []

    def clear_graph(self):
        self.clear()
        self.nodes.clear()
        self.edges.clear()

    def add_node(self, pipeline_id: int, title: str, pos: QPointF) -> PipelineNode:
        if pipeline_id in self.nodes:
            return self.nodes[pipeline_id]

        node = PipelineNode(pipeline_id, title)
        node.setPos(pos)

        self.addItem(node)
        self.nodes[pipeline_id] = node

        return node

    def add_edge(self, from_id: int, to_id: int) -> Optional[EdgeItem]:
        source = self.nodes.get(from_id)
        target = self.nodes.get(to_id)

        if not source or not target:
            return None

        edge = EdgeItem(source, target)
        self.addItem(edge)
        self.edges.append(edge)

        return edge

    def update_edges_for_node(self, node: PipelineNode):
        for edge in self.edges:
            if edge.source is node or edge.target is node:
                edge.update_path()

    def selected_nodes(self) -> List[PipelineNode]:
        return [
            item
            for item in self.selectedItems()
            if isinstance(item, PipelineNode)
        ]


class OrchestratorPanel(QWidget):
    def __init__(
        self,
        db_path: str,
        pipeline_repo: PipelineRepository,
        orchestrator_repo: OrchestratorRepository,
        pipeline_service: PipelineService,
        version_service: PipelineVersionService,
        dependency_service: DependencyService,
        dead_letter_service: DeadLetterService,
        audit_service: AuditService,
        parent=None,
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)

        self.db_path = db_path
        self.pipeline_repo = pipeline_repo
        self.orchestrator_repo = orchestrator_repo
        self.pipeline_service = pipeline_service
        self.version_service = version_service
        self.dependency_service = dependency_service
        self.dead_letter_service = dead_letter_service
        self.audit_service = audit_service

        self.worker: Optional[OrchestratorWorker] = None

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)

        controls = QHBoxLayout()

        self.btn_reload = QPushButton("Recarregar grafo")
        self.btn_reload.setObjectName("PrimaryButton")
        self.btn_reload.clicked.connect(self.load_graph)

        self.btn_connect = QPushButton("Conectar seleção")
        self.btn_connect.clicked.connect(self.connect_selected)

        self.btn_disconnect = QPushButton("Remover conexão")
        self.btn_disconnect.clicked.connect(self.disconnect_selected)

        self.btn_validate = QPushButton("Validar DAG")
        self.btn_validate.clicked.connect(self.validate_dag)

        self.btn_run = QPushButton("Executar DAG")
        self.btn_run.setObjectName("SuccessButton")
        self.btn_run.clicked.connect(self.run_dag)

        controls.addWidget(self.btn_reload)
        controls.addWidget(self.btn_connect)
        controls.addWidget(self.btn_disconnect)
        controls.addWidget(self.btn_validate)
        controls.addWidget(self.btn_run)
        controls.addStretch()

        layout.addLayout(controls)

        self.scene = PipelineScene(self)

        self.view = QGraphicsView(self.scene)
        self.view.setRenderHint(self.view.renderHints())
        self.view.setDragMode(QGraphicsView.DragMode.ScrollHandDrag)

        layout.addWidget(self.view)

        self.status_label = QLabel("Pronto.")
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

        self.load_graph()

    def set_status(self, text: str):
        self.status_label.setText(text)

    def load_graph(self):
        self.scene.clear_graph()

        pipelines = self.pipeline_repo.list_pipelines()

        for index, pipeline in enumerate(pipelines):
            pipeline_id = int(pipeline["id"])
            title = pipeline["name"]

            col = index % 4
            row = index // 4

            pos = QPointF(col * 240, row * 140)

            self.scene.add_node(pipeline_id, title, pos)

        dependencies = self.orchestrator_repo.list_dependencies()

        for dep in dependencies:
            self.scene.add_edge(
                int(dep["from_pipeline_id"]),
                int(dep["to_pipeline_id"]),
            )

        self.set_status(
            f"Grafo carregado: {len(pipelines)} pipelines, "
            f"{len(dependencies)} dependências."
        )

    def connect_selected(self):
        nodes = self.scene.selected_nodes()

        if len(nodes) != 2:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Orquestrador",
                "Selecione exatamente dois nós: origem e destino.",
            )
            return

        source = nodes[0]
        target = nodes[1]

        try:
            self.dependency_service.add_dependency(
                source.pipeline_id(),
                target.pipeline_id(),
            )

            self.audit_service.log(
                action="DEPENDENCY_ADDED",
                entity_type="pipeline_edge",
                details={
                    "from_pipeline_id": source.pipeline_id(),
                    "to_pipeline_id": target.pipeline_id(),
                },
            )

            self.load_graph()

        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Erro", str(e))

    def disconnect_selected(self):
        nodes = self.scene.selected_nodes()

        if len(nodes) != 2:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Orquestrador",
                "Selecione exatamente dois nós para remover a conexão.",
            )
            return

        source = nodes[0]
        target = nodes[1]

        try:
            self.dependency_service.remove_dependency(
                source.pipeline_id(),
                target.pipeline_id(),
            )

            self.audit_service.log(
                action="DEPENDENCY_REMOVED",
                entity_type="pipeline_edge",
                details={
                    "from_pipeline_id": source.pipeline_id(),
                    "to_pipeline_id": target.pipeline_id(),
                },
            )

            self.load_graph()

        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Erro", str(e))

    def validate_dag(self):
        try:
            order = self.dependency_service.get_order()

            self.set_status(
                "DAG válida. Ordem de execução: "
                + ", ".join(str(x) for x in order)
            )

            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Validação",
                "DAG válida.\n\nOrdem:\n"
                + "\n".join(str(x) for x in order),
            )

        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Erro", str(e))

    def run_dag(self):
        if self.worker is not None and self.worker.isRunning():
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Orquestrador",
                "Já existe uma orquestração em execução.",
            )
            return

        orchestrator_service = OrchestratorService(
            db_path=self.db_path,
            pipeline_repo=self.pipeline_repo,
            orchestrator_repo=self.orchestrator_repo,
            pipeline_service=self.pipeline_service,
            version_service=self.version_service,
            dependency_service=self.dependency_service,
            dead_letter_service=self.dead_letter_service,
            audit_service=self.audit_service,
        )

        retry_policy = RetryPolicy(
            max_attempts=3,
            backoff_seconds=1.0,
            exponential=True,
        )

        self.worker = OrchestratorWorker(
            orchestrator_service=orchestrator_service,
            max_workers=4,
            retry_policy=retry_policy,
            actor="ui",
        )

        self.worker.progress.connect(self.on_progress)
        self.worker.completed.connect(self.on_completed)
        self.worker.failed.connect(self.on_failed)

        self.btn_run.setEnabled(False)
        self.set_status("Executando DAG...")

        self.worker.start()

    def on_progress(self, done: int, total: int, message: str):
        self.set_status(f"{done}/{total}: {message}")

    def on_completed(self, result: dict):
        self.btn_run.setEnabled(True)

        status = result.get("status", "UNKNOWN")
        orchestration_id = result.get("orchestration_id")

        self.set_status(
            f"Orquestração {orchestration_id} finalizada: {status}"
        )

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Orquestração",
            f"Orquestração {orchestration_id} finalizada.\n\nStatus: {status}",
        )

    def on_failed(self, message: str):
        self.btn_run.setEnabled(True)
        self.set_status("Falha na orquestração.")

        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Erro", message)
```

```python
# app/views/dead_letter_panel.py

from typing import List, Optional

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QMessageBox,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from app.services.dead_letter_service import DeadLetterService
from app.services.pipeline_service import PipelineService
from app.workers.dead_letter_worker import DeadLetterReplayWorker


class DeadLetterPanel(QWidget):
    def __init__(
        self,
        dead_letter_service: DeadLetterService,
        pipeline_service: PipelineService,
        parent=None,
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)

        self.dead_letter_service = dead_letter_service
        self.pipeline_service = pipeline_service

        self.worker: Optional[DeadLetterReplayWorker] = None

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)

        controls = QHBoxLayout()

        self.btn_refresh = QPushButton("Atualizar")
        self.btn_refresh.setObjectName("PrimaryButton")
        self.btn_refresh.clicked.connect(self.refresh)

        self.btn_replay = QPushButton("Reprocessar selecionados")
        self.btn_replay.setObjectName("SuccessButton")
        self.btn_replay.clicked.connect(self.replay_selected)

        self.btn_discard = QPushButton("Descartar selecionados")
        self.btn_discard.setObjectName("DangerButton")
        self.btn_discard.clicked.connect(self.discard_selected)

        controls.addWidget(self.btn_refresh)
        controls.addWidget(self.btn_replay)
        controls.addWidget(self.btn_discard)
        controls.addStretch()

        layout.addLayout(controls)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 6)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["ID", "Pipeline", "Arquivo", "Erro", "Tentativas", "Criado"]
        )

        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setStretchLastSection(True)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)

        self.table.setColumnWidth(0, 60)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(1, 160)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(2, 320)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(3, 320)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(4, 90)

        layout.addWidget(self.table)

        self.log_view = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_view.setReadOnly(True)

        layout.addWidget(QLabel("Log"))
        layout.addWidget(self.log_view)

        self.refresh()

    def log(self, message: str):
        self.log_view.appendPlainText(message)

    def refresh(self):
        rows = self.dead_letter_service.list_pending(limit=1000)

        self.table.setRowCount(len(rows))

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            self.table.setItem(i, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(row["id"])))
            self.table.setItem(i, 1, QTableWidgetItem(row.get("pipeline_name") or ""))
            self.table.setItem(i, 2, QTableWidgetItem(row.get("file_path") or ""))
            self.table.setItem(i, 3, QTableWidgetItem(row.get("error") or ""))
            self.table.setItem(i, 4, QTableWidgetItem(str(row.get("retry_count", 0))))
            self.table.setItem(i, 5, QTableWidgetItem(row.get("created_at") or ""))

        self.log(f"{len(rows)} dead letters pendentes.")

    def selected_ids(self) -> List[int]:
        ids = []

        for row in sorted({idx.row() for idx in self.table.selectedIndexes()}):
            item = self.table.item(row, 0)

            if item:
                ids.append(int(item.text()))

        return ids

    def replay_selected(self):
        ids = self.selected_ids()

        if not ids:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Dead Letters",
                "Selecione ao menos uma dead letter.",
            )
            return

        if self.worker is not None and self.worker.isRunning():
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Dead Letters",
                "Já existe reprocessamento em andamento.",
            )
            return

        self.worker = DeadLetterReplayWorker(
            dead_letter_service=self.dead_letter_service,
            pipeline_service=self.pipeline_service,
            dead_letter_ids=ids,
        )

        self.worker.progress.connect(
            lambda done, total, msg: self.log(f"{done}/{total}: {msg}")
        )

        self.worker.completed.connect(self.on_replay_completed)
        self.worker.failed.connect(self.on_replay_failed)

        self.btn_replay.setEnabled(False)

        self.worker.start()

    def on_replay_completed(self, results: list):
        self.btn_replay.setEnabled(True)

        ok = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("ok"))
        fail = len(results) - ok

        self.log(f"Reprocessamento concluído: {ok} OK, {fail} falhas.")

        self.refresh()

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Dead Letters",
            f"Reprocessamento concluído.\n\nOK: {ok}\nFalhas: {fail}",
        )

    def on_replay_failed(self, message: str):
        self.btn_replay.setEnabled(True)

        self.log(f"Erro: {message}")

        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Erro", message)

    def discard_selected(self):
        ids = self.selected_ids()

        if not ids:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Dead Letters",
                "Selecione ao menos uma dead letter.",
            )
            return

        reason, ok = QMessageBox.text(
            self,
            "Descartar dead letters",
            "Motivo do descarte:",
        )

        if not ok:
            return

        for dead_letter_id in ids:
            self.dead_letter_service.discard(
                dead_letter_id=dead_letter_id,
                reason=reason,
            )

        self.log(f"{len(ids)} dead letters descartadas.")

        self.refresh()
```

> Se `QMessageBox.text` não existir na sua versão do PySide6, substitua por `QInputDialog.getText`.

Versão mais segura:

```python
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QInputDialog
```

E no `discard_selected`:

```python
        reason, ok = QInputDialog.getText(
            self,
            "Descartar dead letters",
            "Motivo do descarte:",
        )
```

```python
# app/views/health_panel.py

import json

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QFileDialog,
    QGridLayout,
    QGroupBox,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from app.services.health_service import HealthService


class HealthPanel(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, health_service: HealthService, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)

        self.health_service = health_service

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)

        controls = QHBoxLayout()

        self.btn_refresh = QPushButton("Atualizar saúde")
        self.btn_refresh.setObjectName("PrimaryButton")
        self.btn_refresh.clicked.connect(self.refresh)

        self.btn_export = QPushButton("Exportar JSON")
        self.btn_export.clicked.connect(self.export_json)

        controls.addWidget(self.btn_refresh)
        controls.addWidget(self.btn_export)
        controls.addStretch()

        layout.addLayout(controls)

        summary_group = QGroupBox("Resumo")
        summary_layout = QGridLayout(summary_group)

        self.lbl_status = QLabel("-")
        self.lbl_dead_letters = QLabel("-")
        self.lbl_failed_24h = QLabel("-")
        self.lbl_last_orchestration = QLabel("-")
        self.lbl_disk = QLabel("-")
        self.lbl_db = QLabel("-")

        summary_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Status:"), 0, 0)
        summary_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_status, 0, 1)

        summary_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Dead letters pendentes:"), 1, 0)
        summary_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_dead_letters, 1, 1)

        summary_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Falhas 24h:"), 2, 0)
        summary_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_failed_24h, 2, 1)

        summary_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Última orquestração:"), 3, 0)
        summary_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_last_orchestration, 3, 1)

        summary_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Disco livre:"), 4, 0)
        summary_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_disk, 4, 1)

        summary_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Banco:"), 5, 0)
        summary_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_db, 5, 1)

        layout.addWidget(summary_group)

        layout.addWidget(QLabel("Checks"))

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Check", "Status", "Valor", "Mensagem"]
        )

        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setStretchLastSection(True)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)

        layout.addWidget(self.table)

        self.last_report = None

        self.refresh()

    def refresh(self):
        try:
            report = self.health_service.run_checks()

            self.last_report = report

            self.lbl_status.setText(report["status"])
            self.lbl_dead_letters.setText(
                str(report["metrics"].get("dead_letters_pending", "-"))
            )

            checks = {c["name"]: c for c in report["checks"]}

            self.lbl_failed_24h.setText(
                checks.get("failed_runs_24h", {}).get("message", "-")
            )

            self.lbl_last_orchestration.setText(
                checks.get("last_orchestration", {}).get("message", "-")
            )

            self.lbl_disk.setText(
                checks.get("disk_free", {}).get("message", "-")
            )

            self.lbl_db.setText(
                checks.get("database", {}).get("message", "-")
            )

            self.table.setRowCount(len(report["checks"]))

            for i, check in enumerate(report["checks"]):
                self.table.setItem(i, 0, QTableWidgetItem(check["name"]))
                self.table.setItem(i, 1, QTableWidgetItem(check["status"]))
                self.table.setItem(
                    i,
                    2,
                    QTableWidgetItem(
                        "" if check.get("value") is None else str(check["value"])
                    ),
                )
                self.table.setItem(i, 3, QTableWidgetItem(check.get("message", "")))

        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Erro", str(e))

    def export_json(self):
        if not self.last_report:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Saúde",
                "Atualize o relatório antes de exportar.",
            )
            return

        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Exportar saúde",
            "health_report.json",
            "JSON (*.json)",
        )

        if not path:
            return

        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
            json.dump(self.last_report, file, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Saúde",
            f"Relatório exportado em:\n\n{path}",
        )
```

```python
        )

        self.health_panel = HealthPanel(
            health_service=self.health_service,
        )
```

# 22. Testes automatizados do Bloco I

Crie:

```text
tests/test_orchestrator_block_i.py
```

```python
# tests/test_orchestrator_block_i.py

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest

from app.db.database import Database
from app.db.management import apply_management
from app.db.migrations_pipeline import apply_pipeline
from app.db.migrations_orchestrator import apply_orchestrator
from app.db.orchestrator_repo import OrchestratorRepository
from app.db.pipeline_repo import PipelineRepository
from app.domain.pipeline_models import RetryPolicy
from app.services.audit_service import AuditService
from app.services.dependency_service import DependencyService
from app.services.health_service import HealthService


def prepare_db(tmp_path):
    db_path = str(tmp_path / "test.db")

    Database(db_path).initialize()
    apply_management(db_path)
    apply_pipeline(db_path)
    apply_orchestrator(db_path)

    return db_path


def test_retry_policy_delay():
    policy = RetryPolicy(
        max_attempts=4,
        backoff_seconds=1.0,
        exponential=True,
        max_backoff_seconds=10.0,
    )

    assert policy.delay(1) == 0.0
    assert policy.delay(2) == 1.0
    assert policy.delay(3) == 2.0
    assert policy.delay(4) == 4.0


def test_dependency_service_detects_cycle(tmp_path):
    db_path = prepare_db(tmp_path)

    pipeline_repo = PipelineRepository(db_path)
    orchestrator_repo = OrchestratorRepository(db_path)

    p1 = pipeline_repo.create_pipeline("P1")
    p2 = pipeline_repo.create_pipeline("P2")
    p3 = pipeline_repo.create_pipeline("P3")

    dependency_service = DependencyService(orchestrator_repo)

    dependency_service.add_dependency(p1, p2)
    dependency_service.add_dependency(p2, p3)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        dependency_service.add_dependency(p3, p1)

    orchestrator_repo.close()
    pipeline_repo.close()


def test_dead_letter_and_audit(tmp_path):
    db_path = prepare_db(tmp_path)

    pipeline_repo = PipelineRepository(db_path)
    orchestrator_repo = OrchestratorRepository(db_path)
    audit_service = AuditService(orchestrator_repo)

    pipeline_id = pipeline_repo.create_pipeline("P1")

    orchestrator_repo.add_dead_letter(
        orchestration_id=None,
        pipeline_id=pipeline_id,
        file_path="cases/case_001.dat",
        content_hash="abc",
        error="boom",
        retry_count=3,
    )

    pending = orchestrator_repo.list_dead_letters("PENDING")

    assert len(pending) == 1
    assert pending[0]["file_path"] == "cases/case_001.dat"

    audit_service.log(
        action="TEST_EVENT",
        entity_type="dead_letter",
        entity_id=pending[0]["id"],
        details={"foo": "bar"},
    )

    events = orchestrator_repo.list_audit_events(limit=10)

    assert any(event["action"] == "TEST_EVENT" for event in events)

    orchestrator_repo.close()
    pipeline_repo.close()


def test_health_service_runs(tmp_path):
    db_path = prepare_db(tmp_path)

    orchestrator_repo = OrchestratorRepository(db_path)
    health_service = HealthService(db_path, orchestrator_repo)

    report = health_service.run_checks()

    assert report["status"] in {"HEALTHY", "DEGRADED", "UNHEALTHY"}
    assert "checks" in report
    assert "metrics" in report

    orchestrator_repo.close()
```

> Se o nome do módulo de management for diferente, ajuste o import. No código anterior criamos `app/db/migrations_management.py`. Nesse caso, use:

```python
from app.db.migrations_management import apply_management
```

# 23. Fluxo de uso do Bloco I

## Criar pipelines

```text
Pipeline ETL
   ↓
criar pipeline A
criar pipeline B
criar pipeline C
```

Exemplo:

```text
A = Extrair GRID
B = Extrair PORO
C = Consolidar oportunidades
```

---

## Desenhar dependências

No painel:

```text
Orquestrador
```

1. Clique em **Recarregar grafo**.
2. Selecione o nó A.
3. Selecione o nó C.
4. Clique em **Conectar seleção**.

Isso cria:

```text
A -> C
```

Depois:

```text
B -> C
```

Grafo final:

```text
A ──┐
    ├──> C
B ──┘
```

---

## Validar DAG

Clique em:

```text
Validar DAG
```

O sistema calcula ordem topológica:

```text
[A, B, C]
```

Se houver ciclo:

```text
A -> B -> C -> A
```

O sistema bloqueia a criação da dependência.

---

## Executar DAG

Clique em:

```text
Executar DAG
```

O sistema:

```text
1. cria orchestration
2. snapshot de cada pipeline
3. executa A
4. executa B
5. se A e B sucesso, executa C
6. se A falhar após retry, C é pulado
7. arquivos falhos viram dead letters
8. auditoria registra tudo
```

---

## Retry

Política padrão:

```text
max_attempts = 3
backoff = 1s
exponential = True
```

Se pipeline falha:

```text
tentativa 1
falhou
espera 1s
tentativa 2
falhou
espera 2s
tentativa 3
falhou
gera dead letters
```

---

## Dead letters

Na aba:

```text
Dead Letters
```

Você vê:

```text
ID | Pipeline | Arquivo | Erro | Tentativas | Criado
```

Pode:

```text
Reprocessar selecionados
Descartar selecionados
```

---

## Saúde

Na aba:

```text
Saúde
```

Você vê:

```text
Status
Dead letters pendentes
Falhas 24h
Última orquestração
Disco livre
Banco
```

E pode exportar JSON.

---

# 24. Resultado entregue no Bloco I

Com este bloco, o sistema agora possui:

```text
Orquestrador visual de pipelines
Grafo DAG com nós arrastáveis
Conexões entre pipelines
Detecção de ciclos
Ordem topológica
Execução ordenada por dependência
Skip automático de downstream quando upstream falha
Retry configurável por política
Retry de etapas no motor de pipeline
Dead-letter queue persistente
Reprocessamento de dead letters
Descarte de dead letters
Versionamento de pipelines
Snapshot automático antes da execução
Hash da definição do pipeline
Auditoria de execução
Eventos de auditoria para dependências, runs, dead letters e saúde
Relatório de saúde do sistema
Checks de banco, disco, dead letters, falhas e última orquestração
Exportação de relatório de saúde em JSON
Integração com PySide6
Testes automatizados básicos
```

# 25. Resumo dos 3 ciclos

## Ciclo 1 — Desacoplamento

```text
Domain separado de UI e DB
Services isolados
Repositories-only persistence
Interfaces para portabilidade
```

Arquivos-chave:

```text
app/domain/pipeline_models.py
app/services/interfaces.py
```

---

## Ciclo 2 — Modularização

```text
Um serviço por responsabilidade
Versionamento
Dependências
Dead letters
Auditoria
Saúde
Orquestração
```

Arquivos-chave:

```text
app/services/pipeline_version_service.py
app/services/dependency_service.py
app/services/dead_letter_service.py
app/services/audit_service.py
app/services/health_service.py
app/services/orchestrator_service.py
```

---

## Ciclo 3 — Generalização e Refatoração

```text
RetryPolicy genérica
DeadLetter genérico
HealthCheck genérico
AuditEvent genérico
PipelineDefinition versionada
DAG executor genérico
Step retry plugável
```

Arquivos-chave:

```text
app/domain/pipeline_models.py
app/core/pipeline_engine.py
app/services/orchestrator_service.py
app/db/orchestrator_repo.py
```
